in_marathi.name: Buddhadeb
in_marathi.long_meaning: Buddhadeb हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Buddhadeb is derived from Sanskrit. Buddha means 'enlightened one' and deb means 'gift'. So, Buddhadeb can be interpreted as 'a gift from the enlightened one'. This name is associated with wisdom, knowledge, and spiritual growth.
